A system proxy still points to this Mac. If it is used by VoyaVPN, quitting may interrupt internet access.

Open Network settings, then Details → Proxies for the relevant network. Turn off the proxies you set up for VoyaVPN, then quit. Leave other apps’ proxies unchanged.

VoyaVPN could not confirm your system proxy settings. This does not mean your network has a problem.

If you manually set up a proxy for VoyaVPN, turn it off in Network settings → Details → Proxies before quitting. If you did not, you can quit now.
